scope: THREAD-HB C1 negative controls: ud, gp, nx, triple after the switch; nx-boot before it
limitations: TCG (no KVM) on a shared 40-core dev host; up to three lanes ran at once (see each run's load)
QEMU interrupt logs are not kept; their size and last 256 KiB stay on the host next to the logs
logs stay on the dev host under /tmp/nilix-evidence/thread-hb-c1; only their SHA-256 is recorded here
